name: Mouhamed Gueye
detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Derrick White
detail: White (right hip) is probable for Tuesday's game against the Nets.

name: Devin Carter
detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

name: Coby White
detail: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Kon Knueppel
detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Grant Williams
detail: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

name: Kylan Boswell
detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Patrick Williams
detail: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

name: Nic Claxton
detail: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

name: Santi Aldama
detail: The Mavericks assigned Aldama (knee) to the G League's Texas Legends on Tuesday, Marc Stein of The Stein Line reports.

name: Naji Marshall
detail: Marshall (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Heat.

name: Sergio de Larrea
detail: De Larrea (knee) won't return to Monday's game against the Heat. He'll finish with zero points (0-1 FG) and one rebound across six minutes.

name: Caleb Martin
detail: Martin (thumb) is out for Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

name: Dereck Lively II
detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Cameron Johnson
detail: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

name: Alpha Diallo
detail: Diallo (wrist) is out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

name: Spencer Jones
detail: Jones (hamstring) is progressing in his recovery and could be back with the team within the next three games, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Julian Strawther
detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Ausar Thompson
detail: Thompson (ankle) was a full participant at Tuesday's shootaround, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

name: Isaiah Joe
detail: Joe (hip) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks.

name: Jalen Duren
detail: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Moses Moody
detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Marcus Smart
detail: Smart (arm) is out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

name: Steven Adams
detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Ivica Zubac
detail: The Pacers don't have a timetable for Zubac's return after he suffered a left ankle injury Sunday against Brooklyn, but he was able to walk without a boot Monday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

name: Andrew Nembhard
detail: Nembhard (neck/back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

name: T.J. McConnell
detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Bucks.

name: Johnny Furphy
detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Bradley Beal
detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Max Strus
detail: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

name: Jordan Miller
detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Adou Thiero
detail: Thiero (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Portland.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Yves Missi
detail: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Jose Alvarado
detail: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.

name: Chet Holmgren
detail: Holmgren (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns.

name: Alex Caruso
detail: Caruso won't return to Monday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports. He'll finish with nine points (3-5 FG, 3-5 3Pt), three assists and two rebounds in nine minutes.

name: Jalen Williams
detail: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Cason Wallace
detail: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Nikola Topic
detail: Topic (back) won't play in Monday's game against the Suns, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.

name: Thomas Sorber
detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.

name: Otega Oweh
detail: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

name: Jalen Suggs
detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

name: Paolo Banchero
detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Noah Penda
detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Tacko Fall
detail: Fall (quadriceps) was able to practice on Tuesday, Keith Pompey of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

name: VJ Edgecombe
detail: Edgecombe (abdomen) practiced in full Tuesday, Keith Pompey of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

name: Jabari Walker
detail: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.

name: Joel Embiid
detail: Embiid has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Detroit due to right plantar fasciitis management.

name: Dominick Barlow
detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Oso Ighodaro
detail: Ighodaro (oblique) is out for Monday's matchup with the Thunder.

name: Mark Williams
detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Branden Carlson
detail: Carlson (concussion) is listed as questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Scoot Henderson
detail: Henderson is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Lakers due to left ankle soreness.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Dylan Cardwell
detail: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Keegan Murray
detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

name: Ben Simmons
detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

name: Jayden Quaintance
detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Nate Bittle
detail: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

name: Jaxson Hayes
detail: Hayes (shoulder) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Lauri Markkanen
detail: Markkanen (wrist) won't return to Monday's game against Memphis.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
detail: Jackson has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee injury.

name: Trey Alexander
detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: Justin Champagnie
detail: Champagnie has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against Charlotte due to a right foot injury, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG) and two rebounds in four minutes.

name: AJ Dybantsa
detail: Dybantsa, who has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hornets, is progressing well from a left ankle sprain and will take part in on-court activities Tuesday, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Jamir Watkins
detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
